scope: 12-month private-use passenger cars and station wagons, up to and including 4 tonnes GVM, no concession, Class 1 CTP, no input-tax-credit entitlement. Not hire, taxi, business-use or heavy-vehicle rates.

registrationRules.basis: BEVs use the 1–3 cylinder/electric group. HEV and PHEV registration uses the petrol engine cylinder count; the separate hybrid duty discount does not make every hybrid an electric-registration vehicle.
registrationRules.overrideExplanation: X-TRAIL e-POWER has a 1.5-litre three-cylinder petrol engine; use the 1–3 cylinder/electric group even though it is an HEV. Other covered HEV/PHEV configurations require verified four-cylinder applicability; do not infer cylinder count from powertrain alone for future additions.
registrationRules.unknownCylinderPolicy: Require the actual engine cylinder count or an owner-entered registration figure; do not silently classify an unknown hybrid as four-cylinder.

ctp.midpointNote: Arithmetic midpoint of the official published range, for a clearly labelled budget only; not an insurer quote.
ctp.note: CTP is collected with registration. The component amounts above exclude CTP until the annual formula adds it once. Premiums vary by insurer and quarter, not by a private Class 1 driver’s age, driving record or vehicle location. Comprehensive cover is a separate cost.

transfer.note: Buyer fee for a Queensland registration transfer, separate from duty; exemptions can apply. Does not purchase another 12 months of registration.

duty.thresholdBasis: Choose the rate using the original dutiable value, then round up to units of $100. The higher rate applies to the entire value once it is above $100,000; this is not a marginal bracket.
duty.usedDutiableValue: Greater of the total amount paid for the vehicle and its market value. The total includes trade-in allowance and applicable included equipment, dealer delivery fees and warranties; a trade-in does not reduce dutiable value.
duty.newDutiableValue: Use the applicable official list-price/optional-equipment rules, or the official calculator/help tool; a drive-away advertised price must not be treated as the untaxed list price.
duty.note: Assumes an ordinary purchase without an exemption. Current light-vehicle regime applies to contracts from 1 July 2018. Confirm the dutiable value for the actual transaction.

ppsr.method: Official government online self-service VIN or chassis-number search
ppsr.note: Published current fee checked 18 October 2026; commencement date not stated on the source. Search on or just before purchase. Third-party history-report charges are not the government PPSR fee.

insuranceNote: Insurance budgets use published Australian research and explicit model/class estimates. They are not personal quotes. Your actual premium depends on drivers, address, parking, cover and excess; enter a quote to replace the estimate. CTP covers injury liability and is separate from comprehensive property insurance.

insurance.basis: Owner-entered quote or explicitly labelled personal budget; no generic model-specific quote.

homeChargerInstallation.basis: EVSE Australia published typical Brisbane installation range; indicative only, site quote required
homeChargerInstallation.gstBasis: Not expressly specified in the cited FAQ
homeChargerInstallation.note: Do not use as a complete charger-plus-installation budget. Hardware inclusions and GST must be confirmed. Site condition, cable route/distance and single/three-phase supply change the price.

notes: TMR labels the common-vehicle table current as at 1 October 2026 and states Class 1 CTP premiums include GST. Do not add another 10% GST to these published amounts. TMR says its other fees generally do not attract GST unless indicated.

Keep annual renewal costs separate from purchase-day transfer costs. A registered used car usually carries its remaining registration; do not add a whole annual renewal automatically to the purchase total.
Drive-away advertised prices can already include registration and duty. Show an inclusion control or exclude additional duty/registration when already included to avoid double counting.
No concessions, exemptions, short-period surcharges, optional number plates or interstate/unregistered vehicle establishment fees are included.
These are current-rate budgeting inputs checked on the stated date; future years in a projection should be labelled constant-rate assumptions unless changed by the owner.
